Class InMemorySessionRecordRepository

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.test.InMemorySessionRecordRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
SessionRecordRepository
public final class InMemorySessionRecordRepository extends Object implements SessionRecordRepository
who's record of sessions kept in memory, for tests that do not run a database. Thread-safe.
